Cent endings mostly conventional (.50/.75/.95/.00, 88%); a handful of off-cluster endings (.20/.40/.45/.85/.26, 12%) read as genuine lunch-special pricing variance (search corroborated $6.45-$7.25 lunch items) rather than a markup - no single divisor 1.00-1.35 beat plain 1.00 for round/conventional endings. Title confirms San Diego, CA matching worklist.
